bench/web-01-desks: Each desk is run by someone who knows the work, and says who.
bench/web-02-author: The Author desk: four jobs a self-published book needs, each a short form.
bench/web-03-listing: Tell it about the book in your own words and it drafts the listing for you to check.
bench/web-04-errands: The Errands desk plans the errand you have been putting off. You do the last step.
boatready/web-01-describe: Describe your boat in a few taps and see every federal carriage item it needs.
boatready/web-02-requirements: Each item says what to carry and names the federal rule behind it.
boatready/web-03-my-boat: Save your boat, tick off the gear aboard and track flare expiry dates.
boatready/web-04-lights: Tap the lights you see at night and get the vessel and the Rule it comes from.
cancelled/web-01-found: Open a card statement and every recurring charge is listed with what it costs a year.
cancelled/web-02-tracking: Mark each charge Keeping, Canceling or Canceled and watch the canceled total grow.
cancelled/web-03-left-off: Come back and it shows what you meant to cancel and have not marked done.
cancelled/web-04-where-to-cut: A year of statements becomes a ranked list of places to cut, each with its yearly figure.
cast/web-01-library: Every book shows how many voices it has and how much of the opening plays free.
cast/web-02-player-on-stage: The narrator and each character take their own voice, and On stage shows who is speaking.
cast/web-03-chapters: Jump to any chapter, or start over, with the free opening and the full book clearly marked.
conceptionzodiac/web-01-sign: Enter a birthday and the length of term to see the sign that season fell under.
conceptionzodiac/web-02-saved: Keep the whole family in one list and tap any name to see their other sign again.
conceptionzodiac/web-03-two-signs: No length of term? It shows both possible signs and how to settle it.
downpour/web-01-playing: Pick a scene for the table and every drop is synthesized live, with no loop to notice.
downpour/web-02-layered: Layer up to three surfaces and let the rain wind down or fade out on a timer.
downpour/web-03-mix: Choose what the rain falls on, from tin roof to puddle, and set each layer's mix.
downpour/web-04-my-rains: Save a rain by name and share its code so the table can load the same settings.
endorsed/web-01-shelf: Every road, air, water and rail pack on one shelf, with your mastery shown on each.
endorsed/web-02-practice: Each answer explains why and names the federal rule it comes from.
endorsed/web-03-pretrip: Say each pre-trip item aloud, tick it, then put the air brake check in order.
endorsed/web-04-pretrip-score: Your run is scored, with what you left out and a question an examiner may ask.
firstday/web-01-paste-school-email: Paste the school email or photograph the letter, and FirstDay pulls out the dates and items.
firstday/web-02-children-and-warning: Add each child and their school, then choose how much warning you want and when.
flare/web-01-today-log: Rate each symptom from 0 to 10 with one tap, then add sleep, stress, food and a note.
flare/web-02-sample-patterns: Patterns reads your diary and tells you, in plain words, what tends to show up together.
flare/web-03-history: Every logged day at a glance, symptoms ranked by severity beside sleep, stress and food.
flare/web-04-report: Walk into your appointment with averages and severe days summed up, ready to share as a PDF.
fluenthour/web-01-pick-language: Choose one of six languages and your level, then practise ten minutes out loud.
fluenthour/web-02-pick-situation: Pick a real situation, like a broken heater or a missing receipt, and talk it through.
handoff/web-01-log: Every message is sealed into the record, and either parent can check nothing was altered.
handoff/web-02-calendar: Who has the child each day, with the reason recorded whenever a day changes.
handoff/web-03-money: Shared costs raised, agreed or not agreed, and netted, with nothing edited after the fact.
homeroom/web-01-year-checklist: Pick your state and see what it asks this year, each rule with its statute beside it.
homeroom/web-02-log-today: Mark each child in for the day with their hours in a single tap.
homeroom/web-03-portfolio-work: Keep a dated portfolio of work by subject, with a photo or PDF when you have one.
homeroom/web-04-reading-list: A separate reading list by title and author, for states that ask for one.
pantry/web-01-in-the-house: Everything in the house in one list, with whatever needs using soonest at the top.
pantry/web-02-quick-add: Type a name, where it lives and how many days it keeps, one line each.
pantry/web-03-fridge-used-or-binned: Filter by fridge, freezer or cupboard and mark things used or binned as you go.
pantry/web-04-use-these-first: Tonight starts with what to use first, then suggests dinners from what you have.
papertrail/web-01-coming-up: What needs doing next, with why it matters, a one-tap Done and a link to your calendar.
papertrail/web-02-home-schedule: Add what is in the house and the upkeep schedule for each piece appears at once.
papertrail/web-03-service-record: Every job you mark done builds a service record you can hand to a buyer.
papertrail/web-04-add-paste-email: Photograph a receipt or paste the confirmation email, and Paper Trail reads the dates off it.
pillproof/web-01-today-doses: See today's doses at a glance and record each one as taken, with the time and who marked it.
pillproof/web-02-medicines-times: Enter each medicine as written on the box, then tap the times and days it is given.
pillproof/web-03-family-updates: Post family updates and flag the jobs that need someone to pick them up.
pillproof/web-04-appointments: Put appointments in one list and let a family member say they will take them.
potluck/web-01-week: See the whole street's week: what is happening and who could use a hand.
potluck/web-02-lending: A lending shelf for the street, so the ladder gets borrowed instead of bought again.
potluck/web-03-you: Neighbours join free with the code on their door card. One key opens the whole street.
quiet/web-01-keep: A sentence a day, grouped by when it happened, kept in your browser with no account.
quiet/web-02-new-entry: Write a line, record a voice memo or add a photo, and date it whenever it happened.
quiet/web-03-look-back: Search in plain words like the lake last summer and find the moments that match.
soleledger/web-01-schedule-c-year: Your year sorted onto numbered Schedule C lines, with every 1099 checked against your own ledger.
soleledger/web-02-estimated-payments: Enter the yearly total once and see each quarterly date, what is covered, and what is next.
soleledger/web-03-held-out-for-answers: Unclear entries wait for your answer, so the net figure only counts what you have confirmed.
soleledger/web-04-rentals-schedule-e: Each rental unit gets its own Schedule E lines, and repairs versus improvements are asked, never guessed.
spellbright/web-01-menu: Pick an age once and every game sets its words to it, from crosswords to Word Ladder.
spellbright/web-02-robot: A full tile board against a friendly robot, with help one tap away.
spellbright/web-03-ladder: Word Ladder: change one letter at a time to climb from the start word to the goal.
stuck/web-01-first-name-only: A first name and a grade band are all it asks for, nothing more.
stuck/web-02-whats-stuck: Your child types where they got stuck, and Stuck asks the next question instead of giving the answer.
stuck/web-03-children-account: Each child keeps their own sessions, and everything stays in this browser for you to see.
thebinder/web-01-binder-progress: Nine short sections with a progress bar, so you can finish a little at a time.
thebinder/web-02-section-documents: Plain questions about where the will, the lawyer and the paperwork are, answered in your words.
thebinder/web-03-section-pets: Even the pets are covered: who takes them, their vet, and what they need each day.
threshold/web-01-devices: Pick the devices and apps your child actually has, and only those controls appear.
threshold/web-02-in-order: Controls come in order of consequence, so the ones that decide the rest come first.
threshold/web-03-steps: Each control has numbered steps and the date they were last checked against the platform.
throughthegate/web-01-what-they-see: See your resume the way a parser stores it: the fields, titles, dates and skills it kept.
throughthegate/web-02-what-did-not-survi: Every line that never became a field, quoted back to you with the reason it was dropped.
throughthegate/web-03-worth-knowing: Each problem it finds comes with a plain fix you can make before you apply.
throughthegate/web-04-applications: Track every application by stage, and see which ones have gone a month without a reply.
tradedesk/web-01-job-lines: Price a job line by line with parts, labor and tax totalled as you type.
tradedesk/web-02-jobs-list: Every job on one list with its total and where it is up to, from quoted to paid.
tradedesk/web-03-invoice-issued: Issue a numbered invoice from the job, print it or copy it to send, and record payment.
tradedesk/web-04-money: See what you are owed and what came in this month at a glance.
vetpocket/web-01-due: Every treatment for every pet in one list, with the overdue one flagged and a one-tap Done.
vetpocket/web-02-ask: Describe what you see in your own words and ask whether to go now, book, or watch.
vetpocket/web-03-pets: Each pet's breed, ongoing conditions and latest weight, kept ready for the moment you need them.
whoserves/web-01-governments: Type an address and see every government with authority over it, and how many seats they hold.
whoserves/web-02-who-decides: Pick an issue like property tax and see which body decides it, with the law that says so.
whoserves/web-03-county: Every county seat lists who holds it, how they got there and when it was last checked.
whoserves/web-04-letter: Write to the people who decide it, addressed correctly, in your own words.
